names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 7 aprilie, «Sfânta Muceniță Achilina».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Απριλίου, «Αγία Ακυλίνα», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on the second name link behind the three-part line for 7 апреля ст. ст., name page 2374, «Акилина Младшая, мц.», with the rank abbreviation left off. The day’s own line gives the forename alone, «Акилины». **«Младшая», the Younger, is the one word any book read here has given to tell her from the «Акилина» of Byblos the corpus keeps in June**, and it is kept for that reason; no folder holds this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Руфина диакона, Акилины и с ними 200 воинов (ок. 310).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 aprilie — «Sfânta Muceniță Achilina»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Απριλίου — «Αγία Ακυλίνα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and prints no years for her: the only date anywhere on it is the reign of «τοῦ παρανόμου Δεκίου (249 - 251)» inside the notice it quotes from Laura Codex 170, and no `dates` were taken from a reign. The page prints no hymn for her. Unlike doxologia, saint.gr joins her to Rufinus the deacon and to two hundred martyrs, all three on 7 April and all three carrying the same notice; it says nothing of a mother of Calliopius.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
